part.label: Knob With Sphere Cap
part.description: A cylindrical grip stem topped with a sphere, the classic rounded knob shape -- the `sphere` component kind sits with its base (not its center) at Z=0 on its own local origin, the same convention as every other kind, so it composes with `on_top_of` exactly like any other component.

components.description: Rounded cap, resting on top of the stem via an ordinary on_top_of relation.
